newsitem.title: NORWAY: Bad weather halts Statfjord, Gullfaks oil loadings.
newsitem.headline: Bad weather halts Statfjord, Gullfaks oil loadings.

text.p: Stormy weather in the North Sea halted offshore crude loadings at the Statfjord and Gullfaks oilfields on Tuesday and output was expected to be reduced at Statfjord later in the day, Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said.

Waves of up to nine metres were preventing loadings at both developments and weather conditions were forecast to worsen, a Statoil spokesman said. The maximium wave height for shuttle tankers to moor up to the offshore loading buoys is 4.5 metres.
Output at Gullfaks was expected to remain normal but storage capacity at Statfjord was nearing capacity.
"We expect to start reducing production at Statfjord from about 5 p.m. (1600 GMT)," he said.
Three vessels were waiting for a weather window at Statfjord and one at Gullfaks.
